title: 第7章 又报复一次第8章 大炮牌黄瓜
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
李大炮原本就身强体壮，现在得到了传承，踏入修炼的门槛，自然更不一样，不动声色就解决了李大柱。
“大炮，你怎么出来了？”
王美琴吓了一跳，随后才发现，李大柱已经昏死过去。
“这个大柱，竟然敢欺负王姨，我要让他成为太监。”
李大炮说道，不需要阉了他，稍微动了一点手脚，这家伙就算是废了。
“大炮，你别乱来，赶紧放了他，不然要是出了事，你也得负责任的。”
王美琴连忙说道，她觉得大炮现在已经是她的人，必须得负责。
“我是傻子，杀人不犯法。”李大炮说道。
“傻子杀人不犯法，但是会把你关进精神病医院去的，听王姨的，把他扔到外面去就行了，千万别做傻事。”
王美琴继续劝说，她都没意识到，一个傻子怎么可能说出傻子杀人不犯法这样的话。
李大炮答应下来，随后憨憨的问道：“王姨，还要换灯泡吗？”
“换，必须换。”
王美琴激动地说道，随后关了灯，准备再报复她家男人一次。
她觉得李长胜对不起她肯定已经有无数次，那么她自然也得报复无数次。
半个小时后，李大炮拖着李大柱的脚，把他拖了出去，接着扔到了一个臭水沟里面。
“以后就老老实实当个太监吧，看你还怎么调戏村里的良家妇女。”
李大炮拍拍手，随后打道回府，先回家去。
孟晚晴也是厉害，作为城里的千金大小姐，竟然能适应农村的生活。
她还烧水洗了个澡，此刻换上一件蕾丝睡裙，睡裙堪堪遮住了半截美腿，剩下半截白花花的美腿全露在外面，有些晃眼睛。
“不就换个灯泡吗？这都一个多小时了，怎么还不回来？”

孟晚晴暗道，这大晚上的，初来乍到，她心中还是有些怕的。
目前她就认识李大炮一个人，觉得他算半个正人君子，有他陪在身边，心中能够安心一些。
她想出去找李大炮，但是黑灯瞎火的，又不知道去哪里找。
“美女，我回来了，开开门。”
李大炮在外面喊道，今天发生的一切，让他感觉都有些不切实际。
一路上掐了自己好几下，感觉每次都很痛，这才确定这一切都是真的。
孟晚晴连忙打开了大门，随后开口质问：“换个灯泡怎么换了一个多小时？”
“没找到灯泡，所以花费了一个多小时。”
李大炮开口忽悠，看着眼前的孟晚晴，都已经换上了黑色的睡裙。
上半身还是比较正常的，比较保守。
但是到了下半身这白花花的双腿，让他感觉睁不开眼睛。
“那个王姨她家没有男人吗？非得找你去换灯泡？”
孟晚晴问道，这语气，说的好像李大炮是她的男人一样。
“王姨有男人，不过没在家，不知道干什么去了。”
李大炮回道，同样也不知道王美琴今晚为什么要这么做。
“好了，今天把我累坏了，我先去睡觉了。”
孟晚晴说道，随后她回了房间，再关上的门。
李大炮差点撞到鼻子，他连忙敲门：“美女，这是我的房间，你住我的房间，我住哪里？”
孟晚晴重新打开门，问道：“家里没有别的房间了吗？”
“房子都快塌了，就这个房间勉强还能住人。”李大炮回道。
content_en:
Li Dapao was originally strong and strong, but now that he has inherited it and stepped onto the threshold of cultivation, he is naturally even more different. He calmly defeated Li Dazhu.
"Cannon, why did you come out?"
Wang Meiqin was startled, and then realized that Li Dazhu had passed out.
"This Dazhu dares to bully Aunt Wang. I will make him a eunuch."
Li Dapao said that there was no need to castrate him. If he did a little bit of manipulation, this guy would be useless.
"Cannon, don't mess around and let him go immediately. Otherwise, if something happens, you will have to take responsibility."
Wang Meiqin quickly said that she felt that Cannon was now hers and she must take responsibility.
"I am a fool. It is not illegal to kill people." Li Dapao said.
"It's not illegal for a fool to kill someone, but they will put you in a mental hospital. Just listen to Aunt Wang and throw him outside. Don't do anything stupid."
Wang Meiqin continued to persuade, but she didn't realize how a fool could say that it is not illegal for a fool to kill someone.
Li Dapao agreed, and then asked naively: "Aunt Wang, do you still want to change the light bulb?"
"Change, must change."
Wang Meiqin said excitedly, then turned off the light and prepared to take revenge on her man again.
She felt that Li Changsheng had sorry for her countless times, so she would naturally have to retaliate countless times.
Half an hour later, Li Dapao dragged Li Dazhu out by his feet, and then threw him into a smelly ditch.
"From now on, just be an eunuch and let's see how you tease the decent women in the village."
Li Dapao clapped his hands, then headed back home, going home first.
Meng Wanqing is also amazing. As a rich young lady in the city, she can actually adapt to life in the countryside.
She also boiled water and took a bath. Now she put on a lace nightgown. The nightgown barely covered half of her beautiful legs, leaving the remaining half of her beautiful white legs exposed, which was a bit dazzling.
"Why don't you just change the light bulb? It's been more than an hour, why haven't you come back yet?"
Meng Wanqing secretly thought that she was still a little scared after arriving this late at night.
At present, she only knows Li Dapao, and thinks he is a half-gentleman. With him by her side, she can feel more at ease.
She wanted to find Li Dapao, but she was in the dark and didn't know where to look.
"Beauty, I'm back, open the door."
Li Dapao shouted outside that everything that happened today made him feel a little unrealistic.
I pinched myself several times along the way, feeling pain every time, and then I was sure that it was all true.
Meng Wanqing quickly opened the door, and then asked: "Why did it take more than an hour to change the light bulb?"
"The light bulb was not found, so it took over an hour."
Li Dapao opened his mouth and looked at Meng Wanqing, who had already put on a black nightgown.
The upper body is relatively normal and conservative.
But when it came to his lower body, the white legs made him feel like he couldn't open his eyes.
"That Aunt Wang doesn't have a man in her family? Does she have to ask you to change the light bulb?"
Meng Wanqing asked, her tone sounding as if Li Dapao was her man.
"Aunt Wang has a man, but he's not at home. I don't know what he's doing."
Li Dapao replied, he also didn't know why Wang Meiqin did this tonight.
"Okay, I'm exhausted today, so I'm going to bed first."
Meng Wanqing said, then she went back to the room and closed the door.
Li Dapao almost hit his nose. He knocked on the door quickly: "Beauty, this is my room. You live in my room. Where should I live?"
Meng Wanqing reopened the door and asked, "Is there no other room in the house?"
"The house is about to collapse, but this room can barely be inhabited." Li Dapao replied.
